query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM organization_members om
                JOIN member_roles mr ON mr.member_id = om.id
                JOIN roles r ON r.id = mr.role_id
                WHERE om.organization_id = $1
                  AND om.user_id = $2
                  AND om.status = 'active'
                  AND r.code IN ('owner', 'admin')
            ) AS "exists!"
